en.text: Now when morning had come, all the chief priests and the elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death.

zhSimplified.text: 到了早晨，众祭司长和民间的长老大家商议要治死耶稣，

zhTraditional.text: 到了早晨，眾祭司長和民間的長老大家商議要治死耶穌，

en.text: They bound him, led him away, and delivered him up to Pontius Pilate, the governor.

zhSimplified.text: 就把他捆绑，解去，交给巡抚彼拉多。 （徒1·18—19）

zhTraditional.text: 就把他捆綁，解去，交給巡撫彼拉多。 （徒1‧18－19）

en.text: Then Judas, who betrayed him, when he saw that Jesus was condemned, felt remorse, and brought back the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,

zhSimplified.text: 这时候，卖耶稣的犹大看见耶稣已经定了罪，就后悔，把那三十块钱拿回来给祭司长和长老，说：

zhTraditional.text: 這時候，賣耶穌的猶大看見耶穌已經定了罪，就後悔，把那三十塊錢拿回來給祭司長和長老，說：

en.text: saying, “I have sinned in that I betrayed innocent blood.” But they said, “What is that to us? You see to it.”

zhSimplified.text: 「我卖了无辜之人的血是有罪了。」他们说：「那与我们有什么相干？你自己承当吧！」

zhTraditional.text: 「我賣了無辜之人的血是有罪了。」他們說：「那與我們有甚麼相干？你自己承當吧！」

en.text: He threw down the pieces of silver in the sanctuary and departed. Then he went away and hanged himself.

zhSimplified.text: 犹大就把那银钱丢在殿里，出去吊死了。

zhTraditional.text: 猶大就把那銀錢丟在殿裏，出去吊死了。

en.text: The chief priests took the pieces of silver and said, “It’s not lawful to put them into the treasury, since it is the price of blood.”

zhSimplified.text: 祭司长拾起银钱来，说：「这是血价，不可放在库里。」

zhTraditional.text: 祭司長拾起銀錢來，說：「這是血價，不可放在庫裏。」

en.text: They took counsel, and bought the potter’s field with them to bury strangers in.

zhSimplified.text: 他们商议，就用那银钱买了窑户的一块田，为要埋葬外乡人。

zhTraditional.text: 他們商議，就用那銀錢買了窯戶的一塊田，為要埋葬外鄉人。

en.text: Therefore that field has been called “The Field of Blood” to this day.

zhSimplified.text: 所以那块田直到今日还叫做「血田」。

zhTraditional.text: 所以那塊田直到今日還叫做「血田」。

en.text: Then that which was spoken through Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled, saying, “They took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of him upon whom a price had been set, whom some of the children of Israel priced,

zhSimplified.text: 这就应了先知耶利米的话，说：「他们用那三十块钱，就是被估定之人的价钱，是以色列人中所估定的，

zhTraditional.text: 這就應了先知耶利米的話，說：「他們用那三十塊錢，就是被估定之人的價錢，是以色列人中所估定的，

en.text: and they gave them for the potter’s field, as the Lord commanded me.”

zhSimplified.text: 买了窑户的一块田；这是照着主所吩咐我的。」 （可15·2—5；路23·3—5；约18·33—38）

zhTraditional.text: 買了窯戶的一塊田；這是照着主所吩咐我的。」 （可15‧2－5；路23‧3－5；約18‧33－38）

en.text: Now Jesus stood before the governor; and the governor asked him, saying, “Are you the King of the Jews?” Jesus said to him, “Soyou say.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣站在巡抚面前；巡抚问他说：「你是犹太人的王吗？」耶稣说：「你说的是。」

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌站在巡撫面前；巡撫問他說：「你是猶太人的王嗎？」耶穌說：「你說的是。」

en.text: When he was accused by the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.

zhSimplified.text: 他被祭司长和长老控告的时候，什么都不回答。

zhTraditional.text: 他被祭司長和長老控告的時候，甚麼都不回答。

en.text: Then Pilate said to him, “Don’t you hear how many things they testify against you?”

zhSimplified.text: 彼拉多就对他说：「他们作见证告你这么多的事，你没有听见吗？」

zhTraditional.text: 彼拉多就對他說：「他們作見證告你這麼多的事，你沒有聽見嗎？」

en.text: He gave him no answer, not even one word, so that the governor marveled greatly.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣仍不回答，连一句话也不说，以致巡抚甚觉希奇。 （可15·6—15；路23·13—25；约18·39—19·16）

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌仍不回答，連一句話也不說，以致巡撫甚覺希奇。 （可15‧6－15；路23‧13－25；約18‧39－19‧16）

en.text: Now at the feast the governor was accustomed to release to the multitude one prisoner whom they desired.

zhSimplified.text: 巡抚有一个常例，每逢这节期，随众人所要的释放一个囚犯给他们。

zhTraditional.text: 巡撫有一個常例，每逢這節期，隨眾人所要的釋放一個囚犯給他們。

en.text: They had then a notable prisoner called Barabbas.

zhSimplified.text: 当时有一个出名的囚犯叫巴拉巴。

zhTraditional.text: 當時有一個出名的囚犯叫巴拉巴。

en.text: When therefore they were gathered together, Pilate said to them, “Whom do you want me to release to you? Barabbas, or Jesus who is called Christ?”

zhSimplified.text: 众人聚集的时候，彼拉多就对他们说：「你们要我释放哪一个给你们？是巴拉巴呢？是称为基督的耶稣呢？」

zhTraditional.text: 眾人聚集的時候，彼拉多就對他們說：「你們要我釋放哪一個給你們？是巴拉巴呢？是稱為基督的耶穌呢？」

en.text: For he knew that because of envy they had delivered him up.

zhSimplified.text: 巡抚原知道他们是因为嫉妒才把他解了来。

zhTraditional.text: 巡撫原知道他們是因為嫉妒才把他解了來。

en.text: While he was sitting on the judgment seat, his wife sent to him, saying, “Have nothing to do with that righteous man, for I have suffered many things today in a dream because of him.”

zhSimplified.text: 正坐堂的时候，他的夫人打发人来说：「这义人的事，你一点不可管，因为我今天在梦中为他受了许多的苦。」

zhTraditional.text: 正坐堂的時候，他的夫人打發人來說：「這義人的事，你一點不可管，因為我今天在夢中為他受了許多的苦。」

en.text: Now the chief priests and the elders persuaded the multitudes to ask for Barabbas and destroy Jesus.

zhSimplified.text: 祭司长和长老挑唆众人，求释放巴拉巴，除灭耶稣。

zhTraditional.text: 祭司長和長老挑唆眾人，求釋放巴拉巴，除滅耶穌。

en.text: But the governor answered them, “Which of the two do you want me to release to you?” They said, “Barabbas!”

zhSimplified.text: 巡抚对众人说：「这两个人，你们要我释放哪一个给你们呢？」他们说：「巴拉巴。」

zhTraditional.text: 巡撫對眾人說：「這兩個人，你們要我釋放哪一個給你們呢？」他們說：「巴拉巴。」

en.text: Pilate said to them, “What then shall I do to Jesus who is called Christ?” They all said to him, “Let him be crucified!”

zhSimplified.text: 彼拉多说：「这样，那称为基督的耶稣我怎么办他呢？」他们都说：「把他钉十字架！」

zhTraditional.text: 彼拉多說：「這樣，那稱為基督的耶穌我怎麼辦他呢？」他們都說：「把他釘十字架！」

en.text: But the governor said, “Why? What evil has he done?” But they cried out exceedingly, saying, “Let him be crucified!”

zhSimplified.text: 巡抚说：「为什么呢？他做了什么恶事呢？」他们便极力地喊着说：「把他钉十字架！」

zhTraditional.text: 巡撫說：「為甚麼呢？他做了甚麼惡事呢？」他們便極力地喊着說：「把他釘十字架！」

en.text: So when Pilate saw that nothing was being gained, but rather that a disturbance was starting, he took water and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, “I am innocent of the blood of this righteous person. You see to it.”

zhSimplified.text: 彼拉多见说也无济于事，反要生乱，就拿水在众人面前洗手，说：「流这义人的血，罪不在我，你们承当吧。」

zhTraditional.text: 彼拉多見說也無濟於事，反要生亂，就拿水在眾人面前洗手，說：「流這義人的血，罪不在我，你們承當吧。」

en.text: All the people answered, “May his blood be on us and on our children!”

zhSimplified.text: 众人都回答说：「他的血归到我们和我们的子孙身上。」

zhTraditional.text: 眾人都回答說：「他的血歸到我們和我們的子孫身上。」

en.text: Then he released Barabbas to them, but Jesus he flogged and delivered to be crucified.

zhSimplified.text: 于是彼拉多释放巴拉巴给他们，把耶稣鞭打了，交给人钉十字架。 （可15·16—20；约19·2—3）

zhTraditional.text: 於是彼拉多釋放巴拉巴給他們，把耶穌鞭打了，交給人釘十字架。 （可15‧16－20；約19‧2－3）

en.text: Then the governor’s soldiers took Jesus into the Praetorium, and gathered the whole garrison together against him.

zhSimplified.text: 巡抚的兵就把耶稣带进衙门，叫全营的兵都聚集在他那里。

zhTraditional.text: 巡撫的兵就把耶穌帶進衙門，叫全營的兵都聚集在他那裏。

en.text: They stripped him and put a scarlet robe on him.

zhSimplified.text: 他们给他脱了衣服，穿上一件朱红色袍子，

zhTraditional.text: 他們給他脫了衣服，穿上一件朱紅色袍子，

en.text: They braided a crown of thorns and put it on his head, and a reed in his right hand; and they kneeled down before him and mocked him, saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!”

zhSimplified.text: 用荆棘编做冠冕，戴在他头上，拿一根苇子放在他右手里，跪在他面前，戏弄他，说：「恭喜，犹太人的王啊！」

zhTraditional.text: 用荊棘編做冠冕，戴在他頭上，拿一根葦子放在他右手裏，跪在他面前，戲弄他，說：「恭喜，猶太人的王啊！」

en.text: They spat on him, and took the reed and struck him on the head.

zhSimplified.text: 又吐唾沫在他脸上，拿苇子打他的头。

zhTraditional.text: 又吐唾沫在他臉上，拿葦子打他的頭。

en.text: When they had mocked him, they took the robe off him, and put his clothes on him, and led him away to crucify him.

zhSimplified.text: 戏弄完了，就给他脱了袍子，仍穿上他自己的衣服，带他出去，要钉十字架。 （可15·21—32；路23·26—43；约19·17—27）

zhTraditional.text: 戲弄完了，就給他脫了袍子，仍穿上他自己的衣服，帶他出去，要釘十字架。 （可15‧21－32；路23‧26－43；約19‧17－27）

en.text: As they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name, and they compelled him to go with them, that he might carry his cross.

zhSimplified.text: 他们出来的时候，遇见一个古利奈人，名叫西门，就勉强他同去，好背着耶稣的十字架。

zhTraditional.text: 他們出來的時候，遇見一個古利奈人，名叫西門，就勉強他同去，好背着耶穌的十字架。

en.text: When they came to a place called “Golgotha”, that is to say, “The place of a skull,”

zhSimplified.text: 到了一个地方名叫各各他，意思就是「髑髅地」。

zhTraditional.text: 到了一個地方名叫各各他，意思就是「髑髏地」。

en.text: they gave him sour wine to drink mixed with gall. When he had tasted it, he would not drink.

footnotes.text: 27:34 Gall is a bitter-tasting, dark green oil from a wormwood plant that is alcoholic in its effect.

zhSimplified.text: 兵丁拿苦胆调和的酒给耶稣喝；他尝了，就不肯喝。

zhTraditional.text: 兵丁拿苦膽調和的酒給耶穌喝；他嘗了，就不肯喝。

en.text: When they had crucified him, they divided his clothing among them, casting lots,

footnotes.text: 27:35 TR adds “that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet: ‘They divided my garments among them, and for my clothing they cast lots;’” [see Psalms 22:18 and John 19:24]

zhSimplified.text: 他们既将他钉在十字架上，就拈阄分他的衣服，

zhTraditional.text: 他們既將他釘在十字架上，就拈鬮分他的衣服，

en.text: and they sat and watched him there.

zhSimplified.text: 又坐在那里看守他。

zhTraditional.text: 又坐在那裏看守他。

en.text: They set up over his head the accusation against him written, “THIS IS JESUS, THE KING OF THE JEWS.”

zhSimplified.text: 在他头以上安一个牌子，写着他的罪状，说：「这是犹太人的王耶稣。」

zhTraditional.text: 在他頭以上安一個牌子，寫着他的罪狀，說：「這是猶太人的王耶穌。」

en.text: Then there were two robbers crucified with him, one on his right hand and one on the left.

zhSimplified.text: 当时，有两个强盗和他同钉十字架，一个在右边，一个在左边。

zhTraditional.text: 當時，有兩個強盜和他同釘十字架，一個在右邊，一個在左邊。

en.text: Those who passed by blasphemed him, wagging their heads

zhSimplified.text: 从那里经过的人讥诮他，摇着头，说：

zhTraditional.text: 從那裏經過的人譏誚他，搖着頭，說：

en.text: and saying, “You who destroy the temple and build it in three days, save yourself! If you are the Son of God, come down from the cross!”

zhSimplified.text: 「你这拆毁圣殿、三日又建造起来的，可以救自己吧！你如果是 神的儿子，就从十字架上下来吧！」

zhTraditional.text: 「你這拆毀聖殿、三日又建造起來的，可以救自己吧！你如果是上帝的兒子，就從十字架上下來吧！」

en.text: Likewise the chief priests also mocking with the scribes, the Pharisees, and the elders, said,

zhSimplified.text: 祭司长和文士并长老也是这样戏弄他，说：

zhTraditional.text: 祭司長和文士並長老也是這樣戲弄他，說：

en.text: “He saved others, but he can’t save himself. If he is the King of Israel, let him come down from the cross now, and we will believe in him.

zhSimplified.text: 「他救了别人，不能救自己。他是以色列的王，现在可以从十字架上下来，我们就信他。

zhTraditional.text: 「他救了別人，不能救自己。他是以色列的王，現在可以從十字架上下來，我們就信他。

en.text: He trusts in God. Let God deliver him now, if he wants him; for he said, ‘I am the Son of God.’”

zhSimplified.text: 他倚靠 神， 神若喜悦他，现在可以救他；因为他曾说：『我是 神的儿子。』」

zhTraditional.text: 他倚靠上帝，上帝若喜悅他，現在可以救他；因為他曾說：『我是上帝的兒子。』」

en.text: The robbers also who were crucified with him cast on him the same reproach.
Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land until the ninth hour.

zhSimplified.text: 从午正到申初，遍地都黑暗了。

zhTraditional.text: 從午正到申初，遍地都黑暗了。

en.text: About the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, “Eli, Eli, lima sabachthani?” That is, “MyGod, my God, why have you forsaken me?”

zhSimplified.text: 约在申初，耶稣大声喊着说：「以利！以利！拉马撒巴各大尼？」就是说：「我的 神！我的 神！为什么离弃我？」

zhTraditional.text: 約在申初，耶穌大聲喊着說：「以利！以利！拉馬撒巴各大尼？」就是說：「我的上帝！我的上帝！為甚麼離棄我？」

en.text: Some of them who stood there, when they heard it, said, “This man is calling Elijah.”

zhSimplified.text: 站在那里的人，有的听见就说：「这个人呼叫以利亚呢！」

zhTraditional.text: 站在那裏的人，有的聽見就說：「這個人呼叫以利亞呢！」

en.text: Immediately one of them ran and took a sponge, filled it with vinegar, put it on a reed, and gave him a drink.

zhSimplified.text: 内中有一个人赶紧跑去，拿海绒蘸满了醋，绑在苇子上，送给他喝。

zhTraditional.text: 內中有一個人趕緊跑去，拿海絨蘸滿了醋，綁在葦子上，送給他喝。

en.text: The rest said, “Let him be. Let’s see whether Elijah comes to save him.”

zhSimplified.text: 其余的人说：「且等着，看以利亚来救他不来。」

zhTraditional.text: 其餘的人說：「且等着，看以利亞來救他不來。」

en.text: Jesus cried again with a loud voice, and yielded up his spirit.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣又大声喊叫，气就断了。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌又大聲喊叫，氣就斷了。

en.text: Behold, the veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom. The earth quaked and the rocks were split.

zhSimplified.text: 忽然，殿里的幔子从上到下裂为两半，地也震动，磐石也崩裂，

zhTraditional.text: 忽然，殿裏的幔子從上到下裂為兩半，地也震動，磐石也崩裂，

en.text: The tombs were opened, and many bodies of the saints who had fallen asleep were raised;

zhSimplified.text: 坟墓也开了，已睡圣徒的身体多有起来的。

zhTraditional.text: 墳墓也開了，已睡聖徒的身體多有起來的。

en.text: and coming out of the tombs after his resurrection, they entered into the holy city and appeared to many.

zhSimplified.text: 到耶稣复活以后，他们从坟墓里出来，进了圣城，向许多人显现。

zhTraditional.text: 到耶穌復活以後，他們從墳墓裏出來，進了聖城，向許多人顯現。

en.text: Now the centurion and those who were with him watching Jesus, when they saw the earthquake and the things that were done, were terrified, saying, “Truly this was the Son of God!”

zhSimplified.text: 百夫长和一同看守耶稣的人看见地震并所经历的事，就极其害怕，说：「这真是 神的儿子了！」

zhTraditional.text: 百夫長和一同看守耶穌的人看見地震並所經歷的事，就極其害怕，說：「這真是上帝的兒子了！」

en.text: Many women were there watching from afar, who had followed Jesus from Galilee, serving him.

zhSimplified.text: 有好些妇女在那里，远远地观看；她们是从加利利跟随耶稣来服事他的。

zhTraditional.text: 有好些婦女在那裏，遠遠地觀看；她們是從加利利跟隨耶穌來服事他的。

en.text: Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of the sons of Zebedee.

zhSimplified.text: 内中有抹大拉的马利亚，又有雅各和约西的母亲马利亚，并有西庇太两个儿子的母亲。 （可15·42—47；路23·50—56；约19·38—42）

zhTraditional.text: 內中有抹大拉的馬利亞，又有雅各和約西的母親馬利亞，並有西庇太兩個兒子的母親。 （可15‧42－47；路23‧50－56；約19‧38－42）

en.text: When evening had come, a rich man from Arimathaea named Joseph, who himself was also Jesus’ disciple, came.

zhSimplified.text: 到了晚上，有一个财主，名叫约瑟，是亚利马太来的，他也是耶稣的门徒。

zhTraditional.text: 到了晚上，有一個財主，名叫約瑟，是亞利馬太來的，他也是耶穌的門徒。

en.text: This man went to Pilate and asked for Jesus’ body. Then Pilate commanded the body to be given up.

zhSimplified.text: 这人去见彼拉多，求耶稣的身体；彼拉多就吩咐给他。

zhTraditional.text: 這人去見彼拉多，求耶穌的身體；彼拉多就吩咐給他。

en.text: Joseph took the body and wrapped it in a clean linen cloth

zhSimplified.text: 约瑟取了身体，用干净细麻布裹好，

zhTraditional.text: 約瑟取了身體，用乾淨細麻布裹好，

en.text: and laid it in his own new tomb, which he had cut out in the rock. Then he rolled a large stone against the door of the tomb, and departed.

zhSimplified.text: 安放在自己的新坟墓里，就是他凿在磐石里的。他又把大石头滚到墓门口，就去了。

zhTraditional.text: 安放在自己的新墳墓裏，就是他鑿在磐石裏的。他又把大石頭滾到墓門口，就去了。

en.text: Mary Magdalene was there, and the other Mary, sitting opposite the tomb.

zhSimplified.text: 有抹大拉的马利亚和那个马利亚在那里，对着坟墓坐着。

zhTraditional.text: 有抹大拉的馬利亞和那個馬利亞在那裏，對着墳墓坐着。

en.text: Now on the next day, which was the day after the Preparation Day, the chief priests and the Pharisees were gathered together to Pilate,

zhSimplified.text: 次日，就是预备日的第二天，祭司长和法利赛人聚集来见彼拉多，说：

zhTraditional.text: 次日，就是預備日的第二天，祭司長和法利賽人聚集來見彼拉多，說：

en.text: saying, “Sir, we remember what that deceiver said while he was still alive: ‘After three days I will rise again.’

zhSimplified.text: 「大人，我们记得那诱惑人的还活着的时候曾说：『三日后我要复活。』

zhTraditional.text: 「大人，我們記得那誘惑人的還活着的時候曾說：『三日後我要復活。』

en.text: Command therefore that the tomb be made secure until the third day, lest perhaps his disciples come at night and steal him away, and tell the people, ‘He is risen from the dead;’ and the last deception will be worse than the first.”

zhSimplified.text: 因此，请吩咐人将坟墓把守妥当，直到第三日，恐怕他的门徒来，把他偷了去，就告诉百姓说：『他从死里复活了。』这样，那后来的迷惑比先前的更利害了！」

zhTraditional.text: 因此，請吩咐人將墳墓把守妥當，直到第三日，恐怕他的門徒來，把他偷了去，就告訴百姓說：『他從死裏復活了。』這樣，那後來的迷惑比先前的更利害了！」

en.text: Pilate said to them, “You have a guard. Go, make it as secure as you can.”

zhSimplified.text: 彼拉多说：「你们有看守的兵，去吧！尽你们所能的把守妥当。」

zhTraditional.text: 彼拉多說：「你們有看守的兵，去吧！盡你們所能的把守妥當。」

en.text: So they went with the guard and made the tomb secure, sealing the stone.

zhSimplified.text: 他们就带着看守的兵同去，封了石头，将坟墓把守妥当。

zhTraditional.text: 他們就帶着看守的兵同去，封了石頭，將墳墓把守妥當。
